national.title: Normalisasi Kali Ciliwung, Pembebasan Lahan di Cawang-Cililitan Dikebut

international.title: Helen Haines leaves hospital four weeks after alleged attack and double leg amputation
international.summary: The Alfred hospital in Melbourne confirmed on Monday the independent MP had been discharged Independent Australian MP Helen Haines has been discharged from hospital, four weeks after she was allegedly attacked by a man outside her electorate office in regional Victoria and lost both of her legs. The Alfred hospital in Melbourne confirmed on Monday Haines had been discharged, but provided no further detail. Her office has been contacted. Continue reading...
